description: This is a PHP source file for a web interface page that allows users to configure Remote Management settings on a network gateway. It includes PHP code for server-side logic, embedded HTML for structure, JavaScript for client-side interactions and validation, and references to other included PHP files for headers and utilities. The file enables administrators to set up remote access ports, IP range restrictions, and IPv6 configurations for the gateway's remote management feature.

methods.name: IsBlank
methods.description: Checks if all input fields with a given prefix are empty.

methods.name: GetAddress
methods.description: Concatenates input field values with a separator to form an IP address string.
